sin.name: raw-field-in-template
sin.description: A template prints a stored rule id, outcome, model name, level or ISO time as it is kept.
sin.rule: Say a rule through ruleLabel, an outcome through its label table, a model through its noun and a time through TimeAgo or dated. Keep stored words for comparisons and styling. A task's outcome is written text, so the task sections show it as it is.
